ValidationRule.description: Once the booklet has left the facility the applicant is told to track it; the tracking number must exist by then.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "In Transit"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Out for Delivery") ), ISBLANK(Tracking_Number__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Enter the courier Tracking Number before moving the dispatch to In Transit or Out for Delivery.
